Some modules were moved over from the old billing monolith when ledgerly was
extracted in 1.0 and have not been rewritten since.

## Development

```bash
python -m pytest -q
```
# Changelog

## 1.0.0 — 2026-03-02

- Initial internal release: invoices, payment authorization, subscription periods.

"""Entry points used by the support console."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = to_money("500.00")


def process_refund_request(
    payment,
    amount,
    requested_by,
    at,
    *,
    idempotency_key=None,
    approved_by=None,
):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment on behalf of a support agent."""
    # Idempotency must be checked before any validation or mutation so that a
    # replayed call on an already-mutated payment still returns the original
    # result (INC-204).
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("payment_refunded"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    amount = round_money(to_money(amount))
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and approved_by is None:
        raise BillingError("approval_required", str(amount))

    refunded = round_money(to_money(payment.refunded_amount) + amount)
    if refunded > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded
    if refunded == payment.amount:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=float(amount),
        refunded_amount=float(refunded),
        requested_by=requested_by,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment
EOF

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.support import process_refund_request
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(): return Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# rounding
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"49.999","u",T0); print("round", p.refunded_amount)
# full refund
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"100.00","u",T0); print("full", p.status, p.refunded_amount)
# over refund
p=mk()
try: process_refund_request(p,"100.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("over", e.code)
# approval
p=mk()
try: process_refund_request(p,"500.01","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("approval", e.code)
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"500.00","u",T0); print("500 ok", p.refunded_amount)
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"500.01","u",T0,approved_by="mgr"); print("approved", p.refunded_amount)
# idempotency replay on already refunded
p=mk(); process_refund_request(p,"100.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r=process_refund_request(p,"100.00","u",T0,idempotency_key="k1")
print("idem", r is p, p.refunded_amount, len(audit.events("payment_refunded")))
# non-captured
p=mk(); p.status="authorized"
try: process_refund_request(p,"1.00","u",T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state", e.code)
EOF"}
